note: Adapted from the original description on p. 189 of Holmgren 1913c (Termitenstudien 4), original in German; the key entry is on p. 159. That volume describes only the alate (the original begins 'Imago:'), with no soldier or worker description. German decimal commas are changed here to points, the values and ranges unchanged. The base copy is the OCR text of the BHL/biostor scan, whose decimal strings are badly scrambled (6,5 read as 6,fl, 0,65 as 0,05, 1,18 as 1,is, 0,92—1,1 as 0,92 lj); the text was entered after checking it character by character against the archive.org BookReader image of printed page 189 (leaf 188). The species was then placed in Eutermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate with wings 13—16 mm; in the key it is grouped with Eutermes (E.) Havilandi (Desneux), from which it differs in the larger fore wing (11.5—13 mm, versus 10.5 mm) and the narrower pronotum (0.92—1.1 mm, versus 1.2 mm). Head width 1.18—1.25 mm, pronotum length 0.57—0.65 mm. The volume describes this species from the alate only; no soldier or worker is described.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale chestnut-brown, the sagittal suture and the clypeal sclerite paler; pronotum tinged with brown; meso- and metanota pale yellow, only faintly brownish; abdominal tergites pale brown, sternites pale yellow with slightly brown sides; wings greyish yellow with a yellow subcostal stripe. Pilosity dense, wings with punctures and sparse hairs. Head broadly rounded, almost as wide as long; compound eyes large, strongly convex; ocelli medium-sized, almost touching the compound eyes; fontanelle slit-like; head sutures rather distinct; clypeal sclerite shorter than half its width but not very short, rather arched. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than the adjacent segments. Pronotum narrower than the head, longer than half its width, anterior margin straight, posterior margin very weakly concave; posterior margins of meso- and metanota more or less deeply concave, the posterior corners more or less sharp; media with 2—3 apical branches, cubitus with 10—12 branches, of which the inner 6—7 are straight. Measurements: body length with wings 13—16 mm; body length without wings 6.5—7.5 mm; fore wing 11.5—13 mm; head length 1.33—1.48 mm; head width 1.18—1.25 mm; pronotum width 0.92—1.1 mm; pronotum length 0.57—0.65 mm. Distribution: Wonosobo, Java (Jacobson).
